Ultimately, stage one is to replace Python and Django in favor of our existing PHP framework created by our team.
We have thousands of these servers deployed in our data center. All servers are updated via our update notification server so we only have to upgrade to this new version and then we can update all the servers in the data center via our update scripts.



All code is in Git repository. A private repository in our facility. There is a process of working with the code base, push out dev test, release to production where all the servers in the data center have the ability to be updated.



Lastly, after the first stage, then we can begin to migrate CentOS7 to Rocky Linux. Many places online explain how to do it but I think we need to consider something like this moving in batches as it will product down time for our clients. All of our clients are businesses and do not like down time.

Please post questions related to this work.  Only experienced workers should apply, expected delivery time is about one month.  Additionally before hiring, I will require a virtual meeting to fully discuss the project with Q&A.

Uses CloudFlare

Uses MAXMIND for IP detection

To avoid this, we set the filter to 'All Countries' for job posts, but the issue persists for some users, especially those in India and Poland.

But the unsung hero of our business is the process we use to make each project better (and faster) than the last. Here's a our process in a nutshell:

(Step 1) Collect.  Meet with the client, discuss requirements, and start gathering business details & logo, images, service & product information, testimonials, text, video, audio, and anything else needed to build their website.

(Step 4. Care) Launching the website is just the beginning, we also handle hosting, maintenance, plugins, performance, security, etc. Our goal is for clients to become long-term web partners, and every team member should work to foster that kind of relationship.

Some responsibilities you will be expected to assume are:

- Create wireframes or mockups for websites
- Design websites for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices
- Design custom Webflow websites
- Ongoing research and evaluation of new design trends
- Meet weekly with clients to discuss their project and tweak website designs

- Figma for designing websites
- Webflow for developing websites
- Demonstrable web design skills with a strong portfolio
- Extremely effective time management skills, self-motivation, and discipline
- You highly value communication, documentation, and are willing to devote time and effort to both activities throughout the week.


Why This Job Might Not Be For You

You must be able to communicate clearly and frequently via email/chat with me.

You must be able to run deployments on AWS/Docker without assistance.

You must be able to keep a production system STABLE and RUNNING 99% of the time.

You should feel comfortable in communicating mistakes and missteps.  I am not judgmental, but hiding or ignoring errors will not go well for you.

You should be independent and a self-starter.

Technical Job requirements
---------------------
- Excellent English and communication skills (demonstrated via email)
- Strong ability to code in JavaScript, NodeJS, HTML and CSS
- AWS experience (EC2, SES, SQS, ELB primarily, others we can teach)
- AWS DevOps
- Comfort with containers (Docker, etc)
- Automated deployment experience (CI/CD)
- Experience writing unit tests for JavaScript

Non-Technical Job requirements
---------------------
- COMMUNICATION--Like proactively telling me about issues that are happening.  Reporting on what went well.  All without me asking for it.  There's no such thing as over communication with me.
- Friendly with a positive attitude
- Able to meet deadlines on time
- Able to follow instructions clearly
- Able to ask questions when you don't understand
- Have regular, reliable Internet access
- Independent, self-motivating worker
- Strong work ethic
- DETAIL ORIENTED--doing a good job with the code, not just hacking it together to make it work

Nice to haves
----------------
These are skills we'd love to see, but if you lack them, it's OK!  We know a lot of this stuff gets learned on the job:
- Stripe API experience
- Twilio API experience
- Shopify API experience
- WooCommerce/WordPress API experience
- BigCommerce API experience
- Prior ecommerce experience

You need to have TECH LEAD level developer skills.  I expect that you have experience with startups and multiple larger, scalable projects at this point.  It's not a mid or junior level position.

Timezone overlap is important (I'm in the Mountain Time Zone (UTC -6 right now), but not as important as communicating clearly and regularly via email.  

We use a lot of tools on our team for high productivity:
- Slack
- GitHub

QUESTIONS REQUIRED
----
*** You must answer the application screening questions. ***  Failing to do so means we will throw out your application immediately.  "Let's chat or have a call" is NOT an acceptable answer.

VIDEO INTERVIEW REQUIRED
----
You will be required to do a video interview WITH YOUR CAMERA TURNED ON.  Your profile on Upwork should have a photo as well.  If you are unable to perform a video interview, your application will be immediately terminated.  *** No exceptions ***

AGENCIES
----
We are looking for an individual contributor, not an agency.  Thanks for your advance consideration.

Job Title: Build an online CCG mobile game
Description:
I want to build an online collectible card mobile game, both for Android and iOS/iPadOS with the same code base (i.e developed on an engine that can package and deploy the same project on those target platforms)

The game follows the same mechanics than "Triple Triad" (originally from Final Fantasy VIII), so it's a 2-player turn-based game, each player with 5 cards in hand, and a 3x3 board with some special cells (elements, walls). The game should support 7 optional rules from the original set (see Rules section here: https://arrtripletriad.com/en/how-to-play): (1) All Open, (2) Three open, (3) Sudden Death, (4) Random, (5) Plus, (6) Same, and (7) Order. 

It will be Online-only, with a matchmaking system based on Elo rating system (similar to chess). Only one game can be played at a time, and Elo score of both players should be updated after every game.

There's a rank system of Leagues, and "Seasons", similar to Hearthstone (see rules here: https://hearthstone.fandom.com/wiki/Ranked). There will be 6 leagues with 10 levels each (each level with 3 stars, 1 star = 1 game won): (1) Bronze, (2) Silver, (3) Gold, (4) Platinum, (5) Diamond, (6) Legend. At the start of each "season" (configurable, default 1 month), all players start again as Bronze Level 1, but they never lose their Elo rating. Matchmaking will match players within the same League only, with similar Elo score whenever possible.

There's a shop (in-game purchases) that accepts both real money and player coins, where players can build two types of items only: (1) card packs that contain 3 random cards, and (2) season pass that let them play the Season.  

When a player wins, a random card from the opponent cards that he flipped during the game will be won (i.e the loser loses the card, and the winner wins that one). The winner also earns coins (that can be used to buy items from the shop), and 1 or 3 stars (depending if it's on a win streak) to progress in the League.

There's no chat between players during the game, but they can use pre-defined messages and emotes (e.g similar to Clash Royale: https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Emotes#)

Players can build decks of cards with certain restrictions based on the total number of cards they own (see "Deck creation rules" here: https://arrtripletriad.com/en/how-to-play)

The cards database must be configurable, but should have the same parameters than the original initially (i.e same card values and element). So there'll be at least 373 cards (see list here: https://arrtripletriad.com/en/cards). The name and image on the card will feature mythological creatures and heroes instead.

Backend must be built on AWS, and I can help with the design.

UX/look&feel: design must be cartoonish, in 3D but with 2D perspective, something similar to Hearthstone or Clash Royale.

Thanks!

3 x emails with an offer to Segment 1

Segment 3 is existing business contacts who know the founder personally. 

All of them will receive a week's free access to the full site content. Segment 2's offer is that their customers will get the free week's access.

The copy will need to be different for each segment, but the subject matter (i.e. the wine industry info, the deliverables/features they get by subscribing) are the same. So once you study up the content and the info we give you, you'll base it on the same info but customize the copy for each of course.

We need to get started pronto.

Brad

A content writing job involves creating written material for a variety of mediums, such as websites, blogs, social media platforms, newsletters, marketing campaigns, and more. The main objective of a content writer is to produce high-quality, engaging, and informative content that is designed to capture and retain the attention of the intended audience.

The responsibilities of a content writer may vary depending on the type of content they are producing and the specific company they are working for. However, some common duties of a content writer include:

Researching the topic: A content writer is required to conduct extensive research to gather information on the topic they are writing about. They need to ensure that their content is accurate, up-to-date, and relevant to the target audience.

Writing content: Once the research is complete, a content writer creates the written material using an appropriate style, tone, and structure that is optimized for the medium in which it will be published.

Editing and proofreading: Before submitting the content, a content writer must thoroughly check it for grammatical errors, typos, and inconsistencies. They may also need to make revisions to improve the overall quality of the content.

Meeting deadlines: Content writers are typically required to adhere to strict deadlines, which means they need to work efficiently and manage their time effectively to complete their assignments on time.

Staying up-to-date: To produce high-quality content, a content writer must stay informed on the latest trends, news, and best practices in their field. They must also be willing to adapt their writing style and approach to meet the changing needs of their audience.

Overall, a content writing job can be challenging, but also very rewarding for those who enjoy writing and are passionate about creating content that informs, entertains, and engages their readers.

The project requires the services of a skilled content writer who will be responsible for creating a professional business plan with a clear, concise and convincing message. The business plan will include all the necessary sections such as executive summary, company description, market analysis, products/services, marketing and sales strategies, operations, financial projections and funding requirements.

A well-written business plan that effectively communicates the business idea, target market, financial projections, and strategies for success.

An executive summary that captures the essence of the business plan in a concise and compelling manner.

A market analysis that provides a thorough understanding of the industry and the competitive landscape.

A company description that outlines the business's mission, vision, and values.

A product or service description that clearly articulates the benefits and value proposition of the offering.

Marketing and sales strategies that effectively reach the target market and convert them into customers.

Operations plan that outlines the business's day-to-day operations and organizational structure.

Financial projections that include income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial metrics.

Funding requirements that clearly state the amount of capital required, the use of funds, and the potential returns.

The project is expected to take around 2-4 weeks to complete, depending on the scope of the project and the complexity of the business idea. The content writer is expected to provide regular updates on progress and complete the project on time.

The budget for the project will depend on the scope and complexity of the business plan. 

The successful completion of this project will require the collaboration of the content writer and the business owner/entrepreneur. The content writer should be able to effectively communicate the business owner's vision and create a compelling business plan that attracts potential investors, partners and customers.

Press release writer in a business context, it is essential to focus on crafting press releases that support the organization's business objectives. This means being aware of the company's overall strategy and messaging and ensuring that any press release aligns with these goals.

Some key elements to consider when writing business-focused press releases might include:

Understanding the target audience: This includes identifying the media outlets and journalists who are most likely to be interested in the news and tailoring the messaging to resonate with their interests and needs.

Highlighting the business impact: Business-focused press releases should emphasize the tangible benefits or outcomes that the news will bring to the company, whether that's increased revenue, improved customer satisfaction, or other key metrics.

Being strategic with timing: Press releases should be timed strategically to coincide with other marketing or business initiatives, such as product launches, earnings reports, or industry events.

Staying on brand: Business press releases should be consistent with the company's overall brand messaging and tone, to ensure a cohesive and recognizable image to the public.

By focusing on these elements, a business-focused press release writer can help an organization communicate its key messages effectively and generate positive coverage that supports its overall business goals.

- Exceptional creative storytelling abilities
- Proven experience as a copywriter in a brand or product marketing role, with a strong portfolio that showcases your skills in writing compelling, creative, and impactful marketing copy.
- Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills with a keen eye for detail.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with other teams and stakeholders.
- Familiarity with SEO best practices and how to optimize content for search engines.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
- A passion for crafting persuasive messaging and the ability to think creatively and strategically to develop new ideas.

If you have a passion for creating compelling marketing copy and a strong understanding of branding, we want to hear from you. Request to complete our job prompt and help us take our brand and product marketing to new heights.

My brand is Parisienne Farmgirl. (the name signifies my love for French culture and farmlife.  I've had this name for 18 years.)

Allow me to unpack what I do because it's multi-faceted, and I am REALLY looking for someone who can wrap their head around it:

I started as a basic blogger 18 years ago.  Many of my followers have followed me loyalty throughout this time.  They've seen me have six kids, and move to other states, they've watched my business grow, and they've been along as I've explored my love for French and European interior design and incorporated that love into making an income. On the other hand, people are just finding me, and I need these things I do to make sense to them as well. I want them to find my talents (if you will) beneficial for their own lives and, thus, increase sales, as my brand is my family's primary source of income.

I have a Youtube channel with this name. @parisiennefarmgirl
I also have an IG handle with this name and a blog/website. https://www.parisiennefarmgirl.com/ and I invite you to take a look around.

I lead guided Paris flea market tours, which is my main focus moving forward.  It's a brand new aspect of what I do (I recently took action on this dream), and I sold out 18 spaces in three weeks.  I am now booking for 2024.  It's very important for these to sell out.

From my Parisienne Farmgirl platform, I run something called the Old World Design Society.  This is a small, HIGH-quality quarterly magazine focused on home interiors and gardens around the world. When people sign up for my magazine (print/digital) they are given access to a private designers' forum where they can hang out, post their antique finds, share their design dilemmas, etc.  To these members, I teach a monthly interior design class.  Those who don't want to pay for the magazine can join for just the classes and forum at $5 a month.  

This summer, I will expand the shopping experience on my website (where they buy the magazine) to include antiques available for purchase.

I also have an Air BnB decorated in "my style" that is available in a top midwest vacation destination.

And:) I am available for private interior design work.

That being said - I've never had a proper logo.  I want something that would work on everything from my Youtube header/thumbnails to tissue paper for packaging.  When people think of Paris or old-world style design I want them to think of ME.
I want something clean and stylish.  Chic, timeless, and that rings French.  My favorite colors are navy and kelly green... touches of teal and cream.  You will find all these on my website, which I had done last year.  It needs an update, but for the most part, it's fairly recent.

I've been inspired to move forward with this because a good friend of mine just had her logo rebranded and I was stunned (her gig is Italy) and her designer created something that conjured up an olive oil bottle label to me.  I was stunned at the understanding of fonts and colors and how they can impact the observer. I'd love to work with someone who has an understanding of brand development and marketing.

I appreciate you reading all of this and wanting to understand where I'm coming from.  Thank you for your time.

I'm a retired screenwriter turned novelist.  I have been a professional writer for so long I did my first job on a manual typewriter.  Not even electric.  Just mash away at the letters, pure finger power.  Made a great living, retired from the Writers Guild with a nice pension, etc.  

Got bored playing golf.  

I'd thought about moving from scripts to novels for years, but didn't know if I had the chops for prose fiction.  Too old to go to grad school and try to learn that way.  So I decided to let people pay me to learn how to write novels.  
After spending a couple years as a ghostwriter, my confidence in my prose has risen to the point where I no longer want to do work-made-for-hire ghostwriting. I want to publish my own work, under my own name.  

But if there is one thing I've really understood about ebooks - no matter how good they might be, without someone who knows how to launch a book and get the story in front of eyeballs, it's a waste of time.  

I know nothing about publishing.  
Nor do I really care to learn.  
During my many years as a successful Hollywood screenwriter, I had an agent and an attorney to take care of all that business shit. 
I hate selling.  I hate haggling.  I hate tooting my own horn.  

I want a good, professional horn-tooter.  

If you are interested in a gig for hire to launch a novel, let's talk.  
I plan to pay you for your time.  
Expenses like ad buys, beta readers, publicity will be covered by me.
I'm also willing to discuss back-end participation in revenue.  


I look forward to your response, and will follow up with phone interviews to the people who sound like a good match for me.

If you’re not a top performer OR do not have the time, please do not apply. 

WHO ARE WE?

We run a financial comparison website (financer.com), currently up and running in 26 different markets. We have about 50 team members located all over the world.

This position is completely remote, but you do have the possibility to visit our offices in Cyprus if you feel so inclined.

WHAT IS THE WORK ABOUT?

In a nutshell, we do the following:

1. Price comparison. We compare prices for different financial products, such as loans, credit cards, and stock brokers.

2. Reviews. We review most of the products and companies in our comparison, for example, lenders and personal finance apps. Visitors can leave reviews too.

3. Financial education. We write guides and articles about personal finances, for example, budgeting, investing, or getting out of debt. 

As a Country Manager, you are responsible for overseeing the entire market and making sure that everything is running smoothly.

The goal is to be the #1 site in your market. 

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

- Being in charge of the entire market
- Content management. Write new content and update existing content to make sure it’s top-notch (we care A LOT about quality)
- Help recruit more people to your market once needed
- Help us further develop Financer.com with ideas and feedback

SPECIFIC TASKS
- Researching, writing, and optimizing content for SEO. This is probably 60-70% of your work
- Building comparisons and adding products
- Building high-quality backlinks to the website
- Configuring the website and implementing new updates
- Managing affiliate relationships and negotiating deals
- Posting on social media
- Email support for visitors

A Country Manager later evolves into a COO and eventually a CEO as they hire their own people, and their job mostly becomes about leading a team.

In other words, your role is evolving, and your responsibilities and tasks will change with time.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
We’re looking for a very specific type of person. Not an entrepreneur but also not just a worker bee. Let's call it an intrapreneur.

Here are some specific requirements:
- Excellent Kazakh/ Russian writing skills
- Strong interest in finances and marketing
- Driven by responsibility and thrive being in charge
- Passion for learning and growing
- Good command of English, since this is the language that we all speak between us in the company

Beneficial experience
- Understanding of SEO, both on-page and off-page
- Previous work experience with personal finances
- Knowing basic HTML and how to use WordPress
- Experience working independently

WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US

- Pay per hour and performance bonuses
- No fixed hours. You can work where you want and when you want.
- 50 awesome team members located all over the world – finance experts, writers, editors, designers, marketers, and developers
- Work retreats and regular team meetups in different parts of the world
- In-house personal coaching

Not everyone likes our style, but the ones who do seem to really dig it.

HOW WE PAY
- Base hourly rate of €15. Can be increased to €20 once +90% of the content is ranking
- €50 bonus for every new piece of content that receives +100 organic visitors per month
- Profit share of up to 12% based on your market
- Other milestone-based bonuses

If we feel there is a good fit, we will ask you to conduct a video interview with the team leader of the KZ market. If all goes well, we will request some samples of your work and we will test your skills by asking you to offer your opinion on a few pages that have already been published on our website.

Afterward, we will request a test article from you. Finally, if we are satisfied, you will have a new call with the team leader of KZ and the COO of the company.

The test article should be something related to the personal finance/ investment niche, should be between 1000 and 2000 words in length, and will be paid with 50 USD.

Please start your application by writing "Palm tree!", so we know you read it all.

Any effective marketing plan must include copywriting, and doing it successfully calls for a combination of abilities. Understanding your clients' goals will help you as a copywriter create messages that will appeal to their target audience.

Clear expectations about their assignment or deliverables are one of the crucial elements that great copywriters seek for. To generate high-quality work that satisfies the client's needs, one must have a clear grasp of what is required of them. As a result, it's crucial for you, as the customer, to be very detailed about the task at hand, including any special criteria, timelines, and objectives.
The abilities needed for are yet another crucial component that professional copywriters are seeking for the work

The skills necessary for the job are another crucial aspect that gifted copywriters search for. Writing well, comprehending marketing concepts, and being able to create messages that engage and persuade the target audience are just a few of the many abilities needed for copywriting. As the customer, it is your responsibility to make sure the person you choose for the position has the necessary skill set.

The ability to effectively communicate is also essential while creating copy. You must be able to express yourself clearly to your copywriter as the client and provide them constructive criticism on their work. Similar to this, you must be able to clarify things and ask questions when necessary as a copywriter. Everyone must be on the same page, thus effective communication is essential. And the work can be completed to a high standard.

Finally, skilled copywriters are also interested in learning more about your team's working style. For instance, although some clients might want a more hands-off approach, others would prefer to work jointly. Similar to this, certain customers could have particular preferences for the format and presentation of the content they get. By giving the copywriter these facts up front, you can make sure they can adjust their strategy to fit your demands.

In conclusion, skilled copywriters are seeking facts about your working style, the correct skill set, and clear expectations. You may entice the top copywriters and make sure your marketing messages are expertly created by offering these things.

Job Title: Hire a Skilled Content Writer to Elevate Your Brand
Description:
Content writing is a fulfilling and dynamic career that allows you to express your creativity and share your ideas with the world. Whether you're writing blog posts, articles, or other forms of digital content, the role of a content writer is both challenging and rewarding.

Challenges of a Content Writer

One of the biggest challenges of being a content writer is meeting deadlines and producing high-quality work on a consistent basis. It can be tough to balance multiple projects and deliver work that meets the expectations of clients or editors. Additionally, writers often have to deal with writer's block, and finding the right words to express their ideas can sometimes be a challenge.

Another challenge is staying up-to-date with the latest trends and developments in the content writing industry. This requires ongoing research and professional development, as well as a strong understanding of SEO best practices and digital marketing strategies.

Rewards of a Content Writer

Despite these challenges, the rewards of being a content writer are many. One of the biggest rewards is the satisfaction of knowing that your writing has helped others. Whether you're providing information, educating your audience, or entertaining them, your writing has the power to make a difference in people's lives.

Another reward is the flexibility and autonomy that comes with working as a content writer. You have the ability to choose your own hours and work from anywhere, making it a great career option for those who value independence and freedom.

Finally, content writing is a highly in-demand field, with many opportunities for growth and advancement. Whether you want to specialize in a specific niche, become a freelance writer, or work for a content marketing agency, the possibilities are endless.

Content writing is the process of creating written material, typically for digital media, with the purpose of informing, educating, or entertaining a target audience. Content writers produce a variety of content, including blog posts, articles, website copy, product descriptions, email newsletters, social media posts, and more.

The goal of content writing is to engage the reader and to communicate a message effectively. To achieve this, content writers must have a strong understanding of their target audience and the purpose of the content they are creating. They must also be skilled at writing in a clear and concise manner, while still maintaining a strong and compelling tone.

In addition to writing skills, content writers must also have knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO) and the ability to incorporate keywords and phrases in their writing to increase the visibility of their content online. They may also need to collaborate with designers and other stakeholders to ensure that the content they produce aligns with the overall goals and vision of the company or organization.

Overall, content writing is a dynamic and challenging field that requires a combination of writing skills, creativity, and an understanding of digital media and marketing.

Job Title: SEO Content Assistant for Keyword Research, Content Briefs, etc. (NOT article writing)
Description:
Hi, I run a boutique SEO agency and am looking to add a new SEO assistant.

We’re a small team, but our work is top notch. We’re the SEO agency that other SEO agencies hire to save their VIP contracts.

In this particular role, you’ll be working with SEO content – but this is NOT a writing role. Instead, you’ll be supporting the content writers with efforts ranging from performing keyword research to writing blog post outlines.

I don’t expect anyone to have a full, ready-to-go skill set from day one, so I will personally be providing significant training and feedback. But you will need a basic understanding of SEO just so we’re not starting 100% from scratch.

To get more specific, after training you’ll eventually be able to:

- Assess a client’s existing content and make suggestions on which pages to optimize, cut, merge, split, rename, rewrite, etc.

- Perform in-depth keyword research and suggest new articles to write as well as unique angles that will stand out from existing competitors.

- Write outlines for new SEO content, including the SEO title, subheader options, and suggestions for internal/external linking.

- Optimize existing content, which may involve anything from writing alt text to researching an authoritative statistic that we can quote.

- Measure SEO content over time, tracking the results of all your efforts and organizing it in spreadsheets.

- And lots more, depending on your interests.

Because of how small our team is, there’s a ton of room for you to grow. Many of my past trainees have either been internally promoted to much bigger roles, or have launched their own firms/agencies with my support.

I don’t particularly care how many years you’ve been working in SEO, just that you’re a good fit for working with us. Here are some more details on the qualities I’m looking for:

1. Communication
This is about more than just giving status updates. We have some communications guidelines we’ll ask you to follow in order to reduce the number of unnecessary back-and-forth and pointless meetings that could have been an email. For example: Instead of messaging someone “Hey, can I ask you a question?” and waiting for them to say “Yes, what’s up?”, you will have it drilled into you that you should write the full question along with all relevant details in your initial message. Instead of being annoyed, our ideal applicant will appreciate this!

2. Documentation
A significant amount of time and resources will be put into giving you training. You will be expected to take thorough notes on everything you learn. I would rather hire someone who takes great notes than someone who finishes their work twice as fast but has no documentation.

3. Fluency
While you won’t be a content writer, this job still requires native/fluent English to do the work well. But it doesn’t matter to us where you live as long as you can be flexible with timezone stuff for Zoom calls. By the way, start your proposal with the word “jellyfish” and capitalize the 3rd and 8th letters so I know you paid attention to this job description.

4. Flexibility
The work we do is not always predictable. We don’t always have set deliverables where we do the same clearly-defined tasks each month. Because we’re judged by results more than box-checking, we’re sometimes moving around to work on whatever will have the most impact. We’ll always do our best to set clear objectives, but you’ll need to be comfortable with change happening.

5. Love of Learning
There will be a lot of reading and learning that you’ll have to do for this role. It’s just the nature of the work!

Hours: This will start as a part-time role (around 5-10 hours/week) but with plenty of room to expand that over time. You can more or less work whenever you want, but you’ll need to be available for occasional Zoom calls especially during the training period. But once you’re all set up, most of this job will be asynchronous.

Budget: We’ll start with an hourly contract, but can (very quickly) work towards a set retainer if you prefer that. Budget is anywhere between $15-30/hour depending on your starting experience.

Selection process: We’ll shortlist the top proposals and do a combination of traditional interview plus a (paid) test project to further assess your abilities. We’ll pay for one hour of your time to complete a few small tasks that require no prior experience. If there are multiple promising applicants, we may make multiple hires if our budget allows.

Please write a detailed proposal that shows why you’d be the best fit for this role.

-Steven
